title: ReZG: Retrieval-Augmented Zero-Shot Counter Narrative Generation for Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate (SROC) of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting disabled individuals using the Multitarget-CONAN dataset.
Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting Jews and Muslims.
Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting the LGBT+ community.
Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting migrants.
Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting People of Color (POC).
Evaluating the toxicity, relevance, linguistic quality, and countering success rate of model-generated counter-narratives in response to hate speech targeting women.
